Now, tell me if I'm wrong, but isn't there a distinct lack of naughty SCP articles

Yes. It's a shame, ain't it?

I upvoted the whole article (and the supplement), but I would have upvoted anyway for this

Then I definitely suggest you take a look at my newly created author page, particularly near the bottom.

Um… What exactly is going on here?

The app can be used by Foundation personnel, but it ignores almost any changes people make to information in the personnel database anyway. So those profiles may or may not be approved by their 'owners'.

The messaging works, but at least one of the people in the conversation has to be real (for example, when Blanchard says "one of you will have to owe up to this/the app doesn't send messages to itself") and it also functions between two real people who have the app installed. But how do you know whose personnel page is real? How do you know if the person you're talking to is real? That's the thing. (Also, pardon my undoubtedly erratic sentence structure - it's 4 am.)

Edit: To drsciants: You are very observant! And yes, but not as any in-universe reference to it. I just kinda thought that 231, and others, must use a default "image redacted" picture that's used throughout articles/the database whenever something can't be seen (just as a headcanon thing) so that's why I used it.
